name_input: KHOSLA MACHINES PVT LTD.; KHOSLA MACHINES PRIVATE LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for KHOSLA MACHINES PRIVATE LIMITED (644, Sector 16-D) shows "Total Shipments 448 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; visible rows include: "2026-01-07 | KHOSLA MACHINES PRIVATE LIMITED | SARGAM CHEMICAL PVT LTD | WRAPPER 4000TS TOILET SOAP PACKING MACHINE (WITH COMPLATE SET)- JOGBANI INJBNB, India | Biratnagar, NEPAL | 84224000 | 8552479" and "2026-02-28 | KHOSLA MACHINES PRIVATE LIMITED | RECKITT BENCKISER SOUTH AFRICA (PT | SPARE PARTS FOR SOAP WRAPPING MACHINE- 20005-112 TIMING BELT 640X25W POLY CHAIN(OPTI BELT)- DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | CAPE TOWN, S AFRICA | 84229090 | 1129855". Source counter: page claims 448 shipments / 7 trading partners / 9 ports; rows actually visible on the free view = 5 (dates 2026-02-28, 2026-02-26, 2026-02-06, 2026-01-07, 2026-01-06). Destinations seen: South Africa (Cape Town), Nepal (Biratnagar), Ethiopia (Addis Ababa), Sri Lanka (Colombo). HS codes seen: 84224000 (soap packing machine) and 84229090 (spare parts) — declared HS 842240 is consistent with the machine line.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend returned "Connection refused" on all attempts, tofler.in company page returned 404, and volza/eximpedia/trademo/importgenius free views returned 403/JS-challenge. Domestic supply therefore not verified — null, not invented.
note: Real export shipments are documented with dates, destinations, HS codes and B/L numbers (e.g. B/L 8552479, 2026-01-07, Nepal, HS 84224000; B/L 1129855, 2026-02-28, South Africa, HS 84229090), so the company is an active exporter of soap-wrapping/packing machinery and spares, not merely a claimant. Buyer list on the same page (Orange Drugs Ltd, Palmco, RB Pharmaceuticals (Pty) Ltd, Himgiri Hygiene, Zak Ethiopia) corroborates repeat export relationships. Caveat: the 448-shipment figure is the site's own counter and only 5 rows were actually visible, so the full record set is unverified. Domestic (India) supply evidence: следов поставок внутри Индии не найдено в доступных источниках — статус unknown, not confirmed. Note the declared industry "Продукты питания и FMCG" is a mismatch in substance: the company manufactures packaging machinery for FMCG producers, it does not produce food/FMCG goods; HS 842240 (packing/wrapping machinery) is the correct code and should be kept. No rejection grounds: legal entity exists and is actively trading.
